title: KYA SO RAHE HO NEHR PA ABBASE BAWAFA
body:
Zainab ke bain the Mere saqqaye Karbala
Is bekasi me koi Hamara nahi'n raha
Jo Tum nahi'ntoHam pa har ek gaam hai jafa
Ham bekason ko Aake do ab jald aasra
<<MINI>>
Kya so Rahe ho nehr pa AbbaseBawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Tooti kamar Hussain ki jab Tum nahi'n rahe
Aankhon ka Noor ja chuka Akbar jo Chal base
Bewo'n ko aas Tum se thi Shere Jari Mere
Bekas Hussain dasht me ab kisko dein sada
<<MINI>>
Kya so Rahe ho nehr pa AbbaseBawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab jal chuke qayam ridaaein bhi chhin gayi'n
Tab se pada hai ghash meMera Abide hazi'n
Saaya hai asmaan ka aur farsh hai zami'n
Zainab talaya karti hai jalte khayaam ka
<<MINI>>
Kya so Rahe ho nehr pa AbbaseBawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro kar Sakina kehti hai Ammu ab Aaiye
In zaalimon ke zulm se ham ko bachaiye
Behr e Khuda na is tarah mujh ko rulaiye
Gohar bhi chheene ja chuke kurta bhi hai phata
<<MINI>>
Kya so Rahe ho nehr pa AbbaseBawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya jo Tum nahi'nto hain be aas Bibiya'n
Khaimon meSheh ke ek qayamat ka hai sama'n
Tashna labi se bachche sabhi karte hain fugha'n
Rokar Sakina Kehti hai jald Aaiye Chacha
<<MINI>>
Kya so Rahe ho nehr pa AbbaseBawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Mashko Alam ko leke luta Qafela chala
Haamil Alam ka Pyaason ka Saqqa nahi'nRaha
Maatam tha aye Sohail Alamdare Shah ka
The bain sab ke aye Bani Hashim ke Meh laqa
<<MINI>>
Kya so Rahe ho nehr pa AbbaseBawafa
author: Mir Raza Ali Sohail
